verdict.rationale: Visa Intelligent Commerce itself is a proprietary payment/network service with no evidence its core source is openly licensed; however, adjacent components — the Trusted Agent Protocol spec+reference implementation and the agent-toolkit — are published as public GitHub repos with runnable code. No explicit open-source license text is cited for these repos, and the core Intelligent Commerce APIs/platform remain closed. Missing for 10: explicit license statement, evidence that the core Intelligent Commerce product (not just peripheral toolkit/protocol) is open-sourced, independent confirmation of license terms.
